provenance_warning:
These are recorded here from the fan wikis, but nobody has yet opened the
    VGO Emulator client and confirmed them. They may be exactly right, they may
    carry figures the game never used, or they may not be in the emulator at
    all — there is no way to tell from the sources alone.
    
      Of this class's 196 abilities,
      152 have had their tooltip read in game, and 27 were looked for and not
      found .
    
    Where a tooltip has been read it overrides the wikis, and around four in
    five disagreed with them — so treat the figures below with care.
